clue.text: Venerable old monk said part of the rosary

explanation.surface: An ancient monk reciting a section of his rosary prayers.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Part of the rosary' could be a prayer, but it is a physical bead on the string.
explanation.definitionFit: A rosary is a string of beads, each one counted off during a prayer.

clue.text: Labourer's wild punch

clue.text: Lyrics have value for poet

a do is a fuss or commotion

clue.text: Hangman, perhaps, approaches the empty cell

clue.text: Square two, say, to get four, say

clue.text: Mother sometimes going without rest
